input_body.body:
Requesting changes: one behavioural defect against spec R2, plus a behavioural test gap that let it through a green CI. Text findings (docs and workflow comment) and one supply-chain hardening note are inline. CI at this head is green (test, lint; base `main` requires no checks). The one bot thread (style-bot on greet.test.ts:4) is adjudicated not-a-defect and resolved.

Behavioural (must fix this round):
1. greet.ts:7 — R2 requires a blank name (empty or whitespace-only) to exit 2 with the usage line. The guard checks only `name === undefined`, so `bun greet.ts ""` and `bun greet.ts "   "` print `Hello, !` and exit 0 (confirmed by smoke run). Fix: reject when `name === undefined || name.trim() === ""`.
2. greet.test.ts — no test drives the CLI itself, so R1/R2 exit codes, stderr, and the blank-name case are unchecked; add a case that spawns greet.ts and asserts exit 2 + usage on stderr for no-arg and blank-arg, and exit 0 + stdout for a valid name.

Note for the architect: check k1's words cover only "no name given" and miss the blank-name half of R2, which is why the tester's pass did not catch this defect. (Sent separately to the architect topic.)

Thermo (ran at this head; diff touches runtime code): thermonuclear-deep-review CHANGES at 6cc961a7 (High: R2 blank-name defect; Medium: missing CLI test, docs contradiction, workflow trigger/comment; Minor: supply-chain hardening). thermonuclear-code-quality CHANGES at 6cc961a7 (docs contradiction, workflow comment); no structural findings.

Security: supply-chain — actions actions/checkout@v4, oven-sh/setup-bun@v2 tag-pinned (not digest) and no permissions: block at .github/workflows/greet.yml:9-10 (hardening, Minor, no exploit path); untrusted-input — argv name at greet.ts:6 flows only to a stdout template at greet.ts:2, no command/path/query sink. No authz, secret, prompt, sandbox, agent-def, or transport surface touched.

Fast-follow: none

comments.body: Behavioural — R2 unmet. The guard checks only `name === undefined`, so a blank name slips through: `bun greet.ts ""` and `bun greet.ts "   "` both print `Hello, !` and exit 0 (confirmed by smoke run), but R2 requires a blank name to exit 2 and print `usage: greet.ts <name>` to stderr. Reject when `name === undefined || name.trim() === ""` before calling greet().

Behavioural (missing test). Both tests call the pure greet() function; none drives the CLI, so R1's exit-0, R2's exit-2 + usage-on-stderr, and the blank-name defect above all pass a green gate. Add a case that spawns greet.ts (e.g. Bun.spawn) asserting exit 2 + stderr for no-arg and for a blank arg, and exit 0 + stdout for a valid name.

Text — this contradicts the code and the spec. The name is not printed `exactly as it was given, spaces and all`: greet() does `name.trim()` (greet.ts:2), spec R3 requires trimming, and the trim test confirms it. State that surrounding whitespace is trimmed (and, once greet.ts is fixed, that a blank name is rejected).

Text — comment does not match the config. It claims the job runs on every pull request and on every push to main, but `on:` lists only `pull_request:` (no push trigger). Either add `push: { branches: [main] }` or drop the "and on every push to main" clause so the comment matches.

Security[supply-chain] (hardening, Minor). actions/checkout@v4 and oven-sh/setup-bun@v2 are floating tag pins (mutable), and the workflow sets no `permissions:`. While you are in this file: pin both to a commit SHA and add `permissions: contents: read` for least privilege. No stated exploit path (ASVS v5.0.0 CI integrity).
